getCVXCRVUserShareAggregated(address).details: Aggregation flow:         1) userShare = userBalance / totalSupply (1e18)         2) Sum totals across all non-blacklisted pools:             - blacklist source: RewardManager.isPoolBlacklisted(pid)             - pid==0: if pool0Oracle != 0, use IDSFORACLE(pool0Oracle).getCVXCRVHoldings()             - pid>0:  use strategy.getCVXCRVHoldings()         3) Add idle CRV/CVX currently held on RewardManager,            quoted into USDT and reduced by DSF management fee         4) Scale totals by userShare (divide by 1e18)         Returns:           - amountIn_cvx / amountIn_crv: token units           - cvxEarningsUSDT / crvEarningsUSDT: USDT-valued net amounts

returns.amountIn_crv: User share of CRV amount (token units).
returns.amountIn_cvx: User share of CVX amount (token units).
returns.crvEarningsUSDT: User share of CRV earnings valued in USDT.
returns.cvxEarningsUSDT: User share of CVX earnings valued in USDT.

getPendingWithdrawals(address).details: tokenAmounts = what DSF stored in pendingWithdrawals (may differ by DSF logic).      estimatedWithdrawals = recalculated projection from defaultWithdrawPid pool,      using lpShares as virtual user LP balance.      This function is defensive: if estimation reverts for any reason,      estimatedWithdrawals will be zeros (it will NOT break view calls).

getRoundTripEfficiencyForDepositPool(add.details: Round-trip efficiency is a dimensionless ratio (1e18):         - 1e18 means "no loss" (output equals input after simulated deposit+withdraw flow).         Deposit pool branching:           - If pidD == 0:               Uses helper.estimateNetRoundTripByIndex(amountInTokenUnits, tokenIndex)               Helper returns `returnedAmount` in token units (same decimals as input).               Then we normalize both input and output to 1e18 using multiplier `m` and compute:                 roundTrip = (outNorm1e18 * 1e18) / inNorm1e18              - If pidD > 0:               Uses strategy.getEfficiencyByIndex(amountInTokenUnits, tokenIndex)               Strategy returns (depositEfficiency1e18, roundTripEfficiency1e18).               Input amount MUST be in token units (with decimals), not normalized.

params.user: User address (used to fetch wallet balances from helper).

getRoundTripEfficiencyForDepositPoolByAm.details: amountTokenUnits must be in token units (with decimals):         DAI:  50_000 * 1e18         USDC: 50_000 * 1e6         USDT: 50_000 * 1e6    Logic:     - depositPid == 0 → helper.estimateNetRoundTripByIndex()     - depositPid > 0  → strategy.getEfficiencyByIndex()
Amounts must be in token units (native decimals).         Zero amount → zero efficiency.

getUserData(address).details: Combines:         - lpShareRatio:        user share of totalSupply (1e18)         - withdrawalAmounts:   computed from defaultWithdrawPid only (token units)         - roundTripEfficiency: computed from defaultDepositPid only (1e18)         - CVX/CRV:             totals across non-blacklisted pools plus RewardManager idle rewards, scaled by lpShareRatio         - balances/allowances: from helper (token units), mapped to [DAI, USDC, USDT]

returns.allowances: User token allowances to spender=dsfLpContract [DAI, USDC, USDT] in token units.
returns.amountIn_crv: User share of CRV holdings (token units).
returns.amountIn_cvx: User share of CVX holdings (token units).
returns.balances: User token balances [DAI, USDC, USDT] in token units.
returns.crvEarningsUSDT: User share of CRV earnings valued in USDT.
returns.cvxEarningsUSDT: User share of CVX earnings valued in USDT.
returns.lpShareRatio: User share in DSF LP totalSupply (1e18).
returns.withdrawalAmounts: Estimated withdrawals [DAI, USDC, USDT] in token units.

getWithdrawalAmounts(address).details: Logic:         - pidW = dsf.defaultWithdrawPid()         - p = dsf.poolInfo(pidW)         - userRatioInWithdrawPool = userBalance / p.lpShares (scaled to 1e18)         - out[i] = strategy.calcWithdrawOneCoin(userRatioInWithdrawPool, i)         `calcWithdrawOneCoin` expects `userRatioOfCrvLps` in 1e18.

returns.out: Token amounts in token units:         out[0]=DAI (18 decimals), out[1]=USDC (6 decimals), out[2]=USDT (6 decimals).

getWithdrawalAmountsByLp(uint256).details: Simulates withdrawal from the default withdraw pool only.         `lpAmount` is treated as a virtual user LP balance.

params.lpAmount: DSF LP amount to simulate withdrawal for.

returns.out: Estimated withdrawal amounts [DAI, USDC, USDT]                  in token units.

setDsfLpContract(address).details: Owner-only. This contract is the source of truth for:         - totalSupply and user balances         - pool configuration (deposit / withdraw pid)         - decimalsMultipliers for token normalization         Address must be non-zero to preserve consistency of aggregated analytics.

params.newAddress: Address of the new DSFLP contract.

setHelperContract(address).details: Owner-only. The helper is used for:         - user wallet balances (ETH / DAI / USDC / USDT)         - user token allowances to DSF LP         - round-trip estimation when defaultDepositPid == 0         Address must be non-zero to avoid breaking read-only analytics.

params.newAddress: Address of the new DSFHelperMIM contract.

setPool0Oracle(address).details: Owner-only.         Required only if pool 0 does not expose strategy analytics         or has special accounting logic.         Oracle must implement IDSFORACLE interface.         Zero address is disallowed to prevent silent data loss.

params.newOracle: Address of the oracle contract for pool 0.

setRewardManager(address).details: RewardManager is used by analytics to account for harvested rewards         (CRV/CVX) that have already been transferred out of strategies but         have not yet been compounded back into the DSF system

params.newRewardManager: Address of the new RewardManager contract

setTestAmountBounds(uint256,uint256).details: Owner-only. Bounds apply for all tokens (DAI/USDC/USDT) via decimals conversion. Rules:  - newFloor > 0  - newCap >= newFloor  - newCap is not absurdly large (optional sanity cap can be added)

CAP_TEST_AMOUNT.details: Cap (if balance > 0), in whole tokens (not token-units)

FLOOR_TEST_AMOUNT.details: Floor (if balance == 0), in whole tokens (not token-units)

getCVXCRVUserShareAggregated(address).notice: Returns user's proportional share of aggregated CVX/CRV holdings and earnings.

getPendingDeposits(address).notice: Returns user's pending deposits [DAI, USDC, USDT] from DSF LP contract.

getPendingWithdrawals(address).notice: Returns user's pending withdrawal info + computed "how much will be withdrawn"         based on lpShares via getWithdrawalAmountsByLp().

getRoundTripEfficiencyForDepositPool(add.notice: Returns round-trip efficiency (1e18) for each token index, using DSF default deposit pool only.

getRoundTripEfficiencyForDepositPoolByAm.notice: Round-trip efficiency (1e18) for a custom amount and token,         using DSF default deposit pool only.
Round-trip efficiency (1e18) for custom amounts         [DAI, USDC, USDT], using DSF default deposit pool only.

getUserData(address).notice: Returns aggregated analytics pack for a given user.

getUserPending(address).notice: Convenience: returns BOTH pendingDeposits and pendingWithdrawals pack in one call.

getWithdrawalAmounts(address).notice: Calculates estimated withdrawal amounts for user for each stablecoin (DAI/USDC/USDT),         using DSF default withdraw pool strategy only.

getWithdrawalAmountsByLp(uint256).notice: Estimates withdrawal amounts for an arbitrary DSF LP amount.

setDsfLpContract(address).notice: Updates DSF LP core contract address.

setPool0Oracle(address).notice: Updates oracle contract used for CVX/CRV aggregation of pool with pid = 0.

setTestAmountBounds(uint256,uint256).notice: Update FLOOR/CAP bounds for efficiency test amount (whole tokens).
